meta.algorithm: per-layer pairwise swap local search on the objective, started from greedy longest-processing-time (LPT) assignments of the decode and the prefill load
meta.deployment: v7x-16, TP16 attention with flat EP16 MoE (TPU_MOE_EP_TP_SIZE=1): 16 ranks x 16 experts, routed layers 3-77
meta.objective: minimize the time-weighted busiest-rank MoE cost: decode steps at 4 tokens per stream (31.9 us + 11.3 us per active expert) weighted 11.1989/s, full 8192-token prefill chunks weighted 0.3933/s and partial chunks (440.6 tokens) weighted 0.4131/s (200 us + 53 ns per token-expert pair)
meta.routing_profile: per-layer expert hit counts from an AgentX trace-replay serving run at concurrency 32 (MTP 3, 4096-token prefill chunks): 2,508 s window, 1,836 requests, decode and prefill steps
